intro: Ten minutes before curtain, every part in the pit was swapped for something else. The conductor refuses to go on until the real score is found.
echo: Gershwin wrote his in blue; Queen set theirs in Bohemia.

puzzles.title: Tuning Note
puzzles.flavor: The spaces, at least, are honest.

blocks.text: FDYX XDR VNJLBRL VYLLBRS FYM WNX KNES NL MRVLRXM IJX Y MBWKER FNLS VEYLBWRX

hints: Which short words are most common in English? Could any of them be hiding here?

puzzles.title: Fermata
puzzles.flavor: No duplicates anywhere. Half a turn of the wheel and you'd have it.

partials.24bd0c82bf1f2d256de70fa187dad9db75035f62: You've decoded it, but it's not finished. One more layer.

hints: A familiar grid puzzle in unfamiliar clothes. Once it's done, are some squares more important than others? And if what you get still isn't a word, reread the flavour text.

puzzles.title: Tutti
puzzles.flavor: Pairs of numbers pencilled in the margin.

blocks.text: Ten minutes before curtain, every part in the pit was swapped for something else. The conductor refuses to go on until the real score is found.

hints: The first number in each pair never goes past the number of words on the page. What does the second count?

puzzles.title: First Chair
puzzles.flavor: The radio operator had everything back to front, but only from A to Z.
hints: Each word stands for a letter, the way radio operators spell. Do those letters read? If not, try the alphabet backwards.

puzzles.title: Grand Pause
puzzles.flavor: Tidy up the inventory. Half a turn of the wheel and you'd have it.

partials.dabbe12bff21ff06936670fd7b15d20849bca6b8: You've decoded it, but it's not finished. One more layer.

hints: Each jumble is almost a word from this round, but with a letter to spare. Which letter, every time? And if what you get still isn't a word, reread the flavour text.

puzzles.title: Con Sordino
puzzles.flavor: Bunting on the halyard, and not for a celebration.
hints: Ships carry a flag for every letter of the alphabet. Do you know them?

meta.title: Meta: Opening Night
meta.flavor: The last lock takes every signature at once.
hints: Blaise de Vigenère needed a key to open this. Has every answer signed its work?
